text: This staff report is in regards to a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to consider an application submitted by the owner(s) 6 Azzarello Lane, to maintain a Fence greater than 2M on the East side of the 3rd Floor Balcony. They are applying for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to the Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner(s) is seeking Council's permission to be exempt from Chapter 447–1.2. B (1) – Table 1 Item 9 – Any other fence 2M. The subject property of 6 Azzarello Lane is located in Ward 14, on a CR (Commercial Residential) zoned property. This property is an Entrance address for the primary property of 1505 Danforth Avenue. The address faces South toward Azzarello Lane. GENERAL LOCATION CURRENT/ EXISTING CONSTRUCTION AND…
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until the October 18, 2023 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
